goal: status --rollup no longer reports a never-started dependent as blocked_by_prereq when its unlisted prerequisite has a DONE lifecycle in the store: unsatisfied_prerequisites (and the waiting-on detail) list only prerequisite ids without a DONE lifecycle.

graders.name: discrimination-screen
assertions: test_rollup_store_prereqs.py contains a case where the unlisted prerequisite id has only a non-DONE lifecycle in the store and asserts the dependent still reports blocked_by_prereq with that id in unsatisfied_prerequisites

The rollup resolves prerequisite satisfaction through the same store-DONE predicate the scheduler uses (the seam landed by cross-phase-prereq-scheduling), not a re-implementation with different status semantics

relevant: packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_rollup.py -- build_rollup's second pass (~lines 167-194) and _DONE_STATUSES (~lines 47-52); build_rollup already receives the store handle
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_cross_phase_prereqs.py -- the scheduler-side suite the seam-holdout composes with; keep green unmodified
references: The store-DONE satisfaction seam landed by cross-phase-prereq-scheduling in packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_workflow.py -- consume it; docs/data-taxonomy.md is the authority rationale
constraints: A prerequisite is satisfied only by a DONE lifecycle; any other lifecycle status leaves it unsatisfied
Consult the store only for prerequisite ids absent from the classified row set -- fully-listed graphs must classify with no extra store reads
The rollup_to_json shape and RollupStatus vocabulary are stable consumer surfaces -- classification changes only, no schema changes
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done
non_goals: Do not modify files under packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/ except to ADD the new test_rollup_store_prereqs.py; do not weaken or delete existing assertions
No scheduler or re-driver changes -- cross-phase-prereq-scheduling owns those
No renderer/format changes beyond the classification itself
edge_cases: A dependent with two unlisted prerequisites, one store-DONE and one with no lifecycle, reports blocked_by_prereq listing ONLY the genuinely missing id in unsatisfied_prerequisites and the waiting-on detail
An unlisted prerequisite with only a FAILED lifecycle keeps the dependent blocked_by_prereq
A dependent whose every prerequisite is store-DONE (all unlisted) reports not_started, exactly as if the prerequisites were listed and DONE
context.notes: docs/orchestration.md's rollup legend ('blocked_by_prereq: not started, and a prerequisite is not yet done') already reads correctly under store-lifecycle semantics -- verify, and only touch it if the surrounding text contradicts the new behavior.
